name: @etzhayyim/hub-rw-free
description: RW-free impl of hub (self-hosted GitHub-compatible API surface, Consensys c-split). Plaintext public repository catalog + commitStatus facts via sdk.write/read; pullRequest / checkRun / webhook confidential bodies sealed via kotoba E2E (sdk.encryptedWrite/Read, ADR-2605181100). git smart-HTTP object-archive custody, Clerk JWT verification + credential custody (incl. webhook signing-secret), and the merge enforcement action stay etzhayyim via consent-capability. Founder directive 2026-06-03: maximal migration.
